description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
There are three different type of Suzuki OEM Soft Top Hardware Pieces included in this kit.
This kit will provide you with the ability to repair any missing or damaged snap parts that are located on either the soft-top fabric, the Samurai side body, the Samurai tailgate or any combination of those.
OEM Part
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Soft-top Snap (includes both male & female pieces)
Qty 1 – Brass Snaps w/Threaded Posts for Samurai Tailgate
Qty 2 – Male Snaps w/Threaded Posts for Samurai Bodyside
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
